header: We are eleven people in Graz
bodytext:
Kestrel Field Ops started in 2021 as a spreadsheet a dispatcher refused to give up. Four of us had worked in the trade; the rest of us learned it by riding along for a season.

We sell to companies with between three and two hundred people in the field, and we say no to everybody else — a product that fits a two-van plumber and a national chain fits neither of them.
